mapper.select: /*SELECT hst.MSG_TP , date_format(hst.send_req_day, '%m') AS mon , Sum(hst.send_cnt) AS total_cnt , Sum(cd.cd_desc * hst.send_cnt) AS total_cost FROM tblmire_send_hst AS hst LEFT JOIN tblmi_comm_cd AS cd ON cd.grp_id = 'API_PRICE' AND cd.cd_id = hst.usr_grp_cd AND cd.cd_val = hst.msg_tp WHERE hst.send_rst = 0 AND hst.usr_grp_cd = '05' AND hst.send_req_day > '2023-01-20' AND hst.send_req_day < '2023-02-20' GROUP BY mon , hst.msg_tp*/ SELECT prg.PRO_ID , prg.PRO_NM , prg.MIN_START_DT , prg.REG_ID , hst.MSG_TP , date_format(hst.send_req_day, '%m') AS send_mon , Sum(hst.send_cnt) AS total_cnt , Sum(cd.cd_desc * hst.send_cnt) AS total_cost FROM tblmire_send_hst AS hst LEFT JOIN tblmicp_program AS prg ON prg.PRO_ID = hst.PRO_ID LEFT JOIN tblmi_comm_cd AS cd ON cd.grp_id = 'API_PRICE' AND cd.cd_id = hst.usr_grp_cd AND cd.cd_val = hst.msg_tp WHERE hst.send_rst = 0 AND hst.usr_grp_cd = '05' AND hst.send_req_day > '2023-01-20' AND hst.send_req_day < '2023-02-20' GROUP BY pro_id,send_mon , hst.msg_tp
